## Silent workflow check

Set baseUrl and staleHours in Configuration. Select the same Header Auth credential on both HTTP nodes: X-N8N-API-KEY with your n8n API key. The schedule starts at 08:00 UTC.

Each run reads at most 250 workflows and 250 executions. Inspect the returned findings and page-limit flags; an absent execution may be outside this window. No alert is sent. An outage of the hosting n8n instance also stops this schedule.
